scoring_justification: Linear regression slopes of shear properties vs. rho and power-law exponent of tensile strength vs. hole size are recomputed from the agent's CSV tables.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference slopes for μ/ρ, τ_y/ρ, τ/ρ and reference exponent for σ_ult ∝ c⁻ᵐ
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 6 and equations (1), (3), (4) for slopes; Fig. 7(d) and text for exponent 0.35.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper and confirmed against reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported quantitative scaling constants; they are the target for reproduction.

outputs.description: Per-irradiation-condition interfacial shear properties and corresponding areal inter-tube link density. The hidden checker will perform linear regressions of G vs rho, tau_yield vs rho, and tau_sliding vs rho, and compare the slopes to reference values.
Per-irradiation-condition tensile properties and largest hole size. The hidden checker will fit a power law σ_ult ∝ c^{-m} to the data and compare the exponent to a reference value.

output_contract.notes: The checker uses the provided tables to recompute scaling relationships; no raw simulation files are scored.

steps.description: Linear scaling of shear modulus, yield stress, and sliding stress with cross-link density
Power-law exponent of tensile strength vs hole size
